steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp branch from main and plan the 15-step lifecycle.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0024 / t0069 / t0076 are completed and confirm their outputs are available.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure and gitkeep files.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review papers in the corpus for AIS biology, RGC channel densities, slow Kv-AHP mechanisms.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for SK_E2 with extended Ca-binding implementations, qLogNEHVI BoTorch examples, AIS attachment NEURON patterns, and recent RGC tier-stratification literature.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0076 BoTorch MOBO harness, t0024 de_rosenroll_2026_dsgc cell builder, t0069 AIS attachment code, and t0074 SK_E2 vendoring.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesize the 47-d parameter space, AIS construction, SK_E2 extended-Ca-binding vendoring, and the qLogNEHVI / Normalize / subprocess-per-deep-dive fixes into plan.md.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision a Vast.ai 72-core CPU instance similar to the t0076 instance for the BO loop.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build AIS-augmented Bed B library asset; vendor SK_E2 extended-Ca-binding; migrate to qLogNEHVI + Normalize; run 600-800-iteration BoTorch MOBO; collect Pareto front.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the Vast.ai instance, finalise machine_log.json and costs.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis of the Pareto front shape, AIS effects, and channel-tier interactions.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json with Pareto front and hypervolume trajectory.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare the AIS-augmented Bed B Pareto front to the t0076 uniform-density front and to published mouse / rabbit DSI + firing-rate values.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up task suggestions: dendritic-spike machinery if joint operating point not reached, tier expansion for other channels, etc.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, set task.json status to completed.
